whats.CG Power, Mtar Tech, Hitachi Energy Indi: Moneycontrol says AI-linked shares fell amid global tech worries. Markets can swing fast, so judge AI projects on business value, not market mood.
whats.Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI ag: Security for AI agents is now attracting deal talks. If your team plans to use AI agents, ask early how they will be kept safe.
whats.Festo, Softcat, ANS Group and SCC Demons: Companies are linking AI-powered observability, which means watching how systems run, to business results. Ask your IT team what it can show you.
whats.What actually makes a company AI-native?: Being AI-native is about more than buying tools. Ask whether your company is changing how it works, not just adding software.
whats.AI can unearth latent enterprise value: AI may help firms find value already sitting inside their business. Look at what your team already has before buying anything new.

term.def: A company built around AI from day one, so AI shapes its products and daily work. It is not an extra tool added later to old ways of working.

prompt.prompt: Act as an operations advisor. Here is how my team handles [process]. List five steps where AI could save time, and for each one, name the risk and how I can check the output.

quiz.q: TechCrunch reports that Palo Alto Networks is in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M.
quiz.why: That is what the headline says. It describes talks, not a finished deal, so details could still change.

quiz.q: If an AI tool sounds very confident, you can trust its answer without checking.
quiz.why: AI tools can state wrong things in a smooth, confident tone. Always check important facts, numbers and names.

quiz.q: AI chatbots understand your question the way a human colleague does.
quiz.why: They work by spotting patterns in huge amounts of text. They can sound human without understanding like one.

quiz.q: Giving an AI tool clear context, such as your role and goal, usually gives better answers.
quiz.why: AI works from what you write. More useful detail in the prompt usually means a more useful reply.

quiz.q: You need to know coding to start using AI tools well at work.
quiz.why: Most popular AI tools work with plain-language instructions. Clear writing matters more than coding for most office tasks.
